arena: [생존기] Blur reduces all damage taken by 25% for 10 sec. Time it to the moment the enemy pops their burst cooldowns.
[회피] With Glimpse, you're immune to CC while leaping with Vengeful Retreat and take 20% less damage until you land. Leap back right before an enemy CC cast finishes.
[회피] Shift teleports you to a chosen spot within 30 yds. When melee DPS are on you, move behind a pillar to break line of sight or return to your healer.
[해제] Reverse Magic removes all harmful magic effects from you and allies within 10 yds and reflects them to the caster. Use it immediately when magic CC lands near your healer.
[해제] Consume Magic removes one beneficial magic effect from a target up to 30 yds away. Strip the enemy's magic protection effects first.
[제어] Imprison incapacitates the target for 1 min but damage can break it. Put it on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[차단] Disrupt interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[참고] With Beckon, your next Consume after Reap has no cast time and creates an extra Soul Fragment. When the enemy interrupt is available, weave Consume in after Reap.
bg: [참고] On flag maps, if a healer can't carry, a mobile DPS carries. When you have the flag, clear all slows with Vengeful Retreat and gain distance from chasers with Shift.

[생존기] Armor of Souls was picked by 26 of 43 Battleground Blitz players. It increases Armor by 65% and has a 12% chance to create a Soul Fragment when you take damage, so you can build the Soul Fragments needed for Void Metamorphosis even in long base teamfights.

[제어] Sigil of Misery disorients all enemies on the sigil for 15 sec after 2 sec, but disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
[분담] Spectral Sight reveals stealthed and invisible enemies for 8 sec. When defending a base, check whether enemy stealth classes are sneaking in to capture.
[해제] Reverse Magic removes all harmful magic effects from allies within 10 yds. Use it when several magic CC effects land on allies stacked on a base.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Blur right before the burst.
pvpTalents: Beckon, picked by all top 47 Solo Shuffle players and all 43 Battleground Blitz players, makes your next Consume after Reap instant and grants an extra Soul Fragment. Glimpse, picked by 37 of 47 Solo Shuffle and 39 of 43 Battleground Blitz players, grants CC immunity and 20% damage reduction during Vengeful Retreat. Reverse Magic, picked by 27 of 47 Solo Shuffle players, removes all harmful magic effects from you and allies within 10 yds and reflects them to the caster.

205604.d: Removes all harmful magical effects from yourself and all nearby allies within 10 yards, and sends them back to their original caster if possible.

354489.d: Vengeful Retreat provides immunity to loss of control effects, and reduces damage taken by 20% until you land.

1261414.d: Your Armor is increased by 65%. Taking damage has a 12% chance to generate a Soul Fragment. (Proc chance: 12%)

1261697.d: Reap reduces the cast time of your next Consume by 100% and causes it to generate 1 additional Soul Fragment.

205604.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
205604.d: 자신과 주위 10미터 내의 모든 아군에게서 해로운 마법 효과를 제거하고, 가능한 경우 해당 효과를 시전한 대상에게 되돌려줍니다.

354489.d: 복수의 퇴각이 제어 불가 효과에 면역으로 만들며 착지할 때까지 받는 피해를 20%만큼 감소시킵니다.

1261414.d: 방어도가 65%만큼 증가합니다. 피해를 받으면 12%의 확률로 영혼 파편을 생성합니다. (효과 발동 확률: 12%)

1261697.d: 수확이 다음 집어삼키기의 시전 시간을 100%만큼 감소시키며, 영혼 파편 1개를 추가로 생성하게 합니다.
